name: t_reaction
notes: Frozen human reaction time. Bounded by expected (0.7s) and surprise (1.5s) paradigms.

name: u_human_accel
notes: Identically 0.0 for all t per L3 out-of-loop handover framing.

name: u_human_brake_target
notes: Normalized step command to full demand at t_reaction.

name: a_max
evidence_provenance: General vehicle dynamics consensus / dry asphalt AEB
notes: Held constant across all compared profiles to isolate transient shape from capacity.

name: t_delay
notes: Hydraulic friction brake response delay. Held constant across R0/R2.

name: withdrawal_policy
notes: W0: automation maintains v0 until t_reaction; W1: automation withdraws at t=0, coasting until t_reaction.

name: a_coast
evidence_provenance: OpenLKA EV Kinematic Dataset fleet D004 + SAE 2012-01-0616 coast-down
notes: Active only during [0 t_reaction) under W1. Distinguishes coast-down dynamics.

name: t_buildup
notes: Linear ramp time from actuation delay to a_max.

name: v0
notes: Controlled initial cruise speed at TOR issuance.

name: tor_lead_time
notes: Determines reference hazard distance x_hazard = v0 * tor_lead_time.

name: v_rolloff_active
notes: Low-speed roll-off fade. Retained sensitivity-only; not required for core A1 claim.

name: v_threshold
notes: Speed below which regen torque fades toward standstill.

name: dt
notes: Validated nominal timestep in A0 (convergence order p=1.0001).
